name: Group Work Day
description: A shared to-do list for classwork: split into groups, every group gets the same checklist on their devices, and the projector shows every group's live progress. For lab days, station rotations, project work — any 'here's what your group must finish today'. No points, no winners: completion tracking.
tagline: Perfect for labs, stations, and project sessions where every group works the same task list.

tasks.label: The to-do items
tasks.helper: The tasks every group must finish. Any group member can check one off — the whole group sees it instantly.
default: Check your answers with another group

groupSize.label: Students per group
groupSize.helper: Groups of this size (a 22-kid class in groups of 4 makes 4,4,4,4,3,3 — nobody works alone).

method.label: How groups form
method.helper: random: instant. choice: students tap the group they want. teacher: you arrange names on the projector.

workTime.label: Work time (seconds, optional)
workTime.helper: A visible countdown for the work session. Leave empty for no limit — you end work time from the host screen.

template.name: Group Work Day
template.description: A shared group checklist with a live progress board, built with the Group Work Day recipe.

intro.message:
GROUP WORK DAY!

You're about to be split into groups. Every group has the same checklist on their devices — check tasks off as your group finishes them, and watch the progress board up here.

worktime.prompt: Work through today's tasks with your group.

end.message: That's a wrap on today's work session.
